li.a: Follow openjdk guidelines for class header wrapping

subsection.name: Description
subsection.div:
Checks that a wrapped class, interface, enum, or record header is wrapped according to the
OpenJDK Java Style Guide.
subsection.p: This check only applies when the type declaration header, from the declaration keyword through the opening curly brace, spans more than one line. Single-line headers are not in scope.

ol.li: Each of the extends and implements clauses, when present, must stand out on its own new line once the header has started wrapping, or once that clause's own list of supertypes wraps across lines. Wrapping that happens only inside a single supertype's type arguments (the same way method arguments may wrap) does not require the clause keyword itself to move to a new line.
Only checked when rule 1 above found nothing to report: the header should not have been wrapped in the first place if, joined back onto one line, it would still fit within 80 columns.
